label: Lab 14
title: Can an AI jury judge how a room looks?
question: Can a jury of AI models, scoring pictures blind, tell how good a room looks, and how much does its score move when nothing changed?
how: Two blind rounds of the same rubric, with a calibration pair that takes a juror off when it cannot tell a good picture from a ruined one. Rooms that were not reworked show the jury's noise. Numbers only, no pictures.
status: Judged by AI models, not people · cited by hash
